courseTitle: 100 Days of Code: JavaScript Data Structures and Algorithms

cues.en: Now, we have said that there are different types of the sorting algorithm.
So that's why you need to know that when to use that algorithm and when to avoid them.
So after each sorting algorithm, I put this short lecture to understand when to use that algorithm.
So in this case it is for bubble sort.
So when we can use the bubble sort, when the input is almost sorted and the space is a concern.
So we know that it takes O one space complexity.
And this is easy to implement.
So when you need a fast solution you can use this.
Now when it comes to the time complexity, the average time complexity is poor for bubble sort.
So when the time complexity is concerned you need to avoid the bubble sort.
So these are the points that you need to take into account when you implement the bubble sort.
